ReadMe.Statement: DRAFT v0.1 — companion registry authored 2026-09-05 from the RATIFIED KG Layer 4 section of the AIVIA Design Document (protocol step 2). The doc is the authority; any doc change updates this registry in the same breath. All build deferred by the phase ruling.
The lens computes; a human touch mints. Sparse by design: every concept a human has engaged, never every cluster the math can find.

Node_and_Edges.Definition: id (content-keyed at minting) + basis (family snapshot: member tree versions, lens version). NO name, NO description — the accepted parent term IS its identity
term.about -> concept; disposition.about -> concept; lens reports reference by id (not edges)
NEVER stored — the relatedness lens recomputes; basis-vs-now divergence is the concept-drift lens

Rules_to_Checks.Check asserts: every concept's minting act traces to a human ruling or acceptance; no machine mint path exists
no edit/delete path on minted concepts
node shape validates; no member edges exist

Merged_Into_Governance.Definition: twin-graph ruling (2026-09-06) 2f: SUPERSEDED AS A LAYER — concept is a citizen class of the governance overlay (kg3_artifacts Governance_Overlay sheet). Sheets below stand as the ratified class-rule record.
